last_note: T032 complete. Wired real OutboxRelay (KafkaTemplate producer) behind the already-existing IOutboxService abstraction from T030/T031. Widened IOutboxService.publish to take an explicit partitionKey (connection_id) per the kafka-outbox skill's ordering rule, and updated all three existing call sites (connection.requested, connection.accepted, connection.expired) in ConnectionServiceImpl to pass it. OutboxEvent's id is now an app-assigned UUID (was BIGINT IDENTITY) so it can double as event_id groundwork for consumer dedup. New V004 migration drops/recreates the outbox table (empty, pre-production) adding partition_key + processed_at columns and the UUID PK. Kept the connection-service repository naming convention (OutboxRepository, not IOutboxRepository) per the project's java-repository-naming decision, overriding the ticket text's IOutboxRepository name. No CLI codegen commands were needed or run (spring-kafka, KAFKA_BROKERS config, and @EnableScheduling already existed from earlier tickets).
